title: Proximal Alternating Linearized Minimization for Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Problems

relevant_locations.content: Generic PALM algorithm, equations (3.3)-(3.4): block reciprocal step parameters gamma_i times current partial-gradient Lipschitz moduli, gamma_i > 1.
Convex nonsmooth block terms allow reciprocal step parameters equal to current Lipschitz moduli. Item (iii) gives sufficient descent for reciprocal step > L_h/2.
Nonnegative matrix-factorization case explicitly invokes convex-constraint simplification.
